note: Wheels built here because no published wheel exists for the target. Filled from the build record after sls runs INTEL-CRYPTO-WHEEL-PASTE.txt; an artifact is accepted only by its sha256. proxy-tools has no published wheel at all, and every pywebview after 3.4 requires it.

wheels.openssl: 4.0.3 (static, no-module: the legacy provider is built in; prefix, openssldir and libdir /private/etc/ssl)
wheels.built_with: CPython 3.11 x86_64 under Rosetta, maturin 1.15.0, rustc 1.93.1 target x86_64-apple-darwin; OpenSSL Configure darwin64-x86_64-cc no-shared no-module no-tests no-docs --prefix=/private/etc/ssl --openssldir=/private/etc/ssl --libdir=/private/etc/ssl/lib -mmacosx-version-min=14.0; RUSTFLAGS --remap-path-prefix for the cargo registry, git checkouts, rustup, the build dir and the home dir
wheels.built_on: 2026-10-07 (v4: no builder paths, and OpenSSL's directories under /private/etc/ssl)
